rule: R60 -- a reader is shown returning KNOWN answers on hand-read pages before it is trusted on pages nobody has read. Law 1 -- every control states the condition under which it fails.

controls.asserts: cop/chromakey -- the 15 hand-read parameter LABELS, in document order
controls.fails_if: the parser adds, drops or re-orders any parameter on a page read by hand

controls.asserts: cop/chromakey -- the 15 hand-read #id values (evidence, not the key)
controls.fails_if: an #id is bound to the wrong label, or lost

controls.asserts: cop/chromakey -- title, summary, rung, header order
controls.fails_if: the summary regex loses the trailing sentence, or the rung ladder mis-scores a full page
expected: Keys an input based on hue, saturation, and luminance ranges.
got: Keys an input based on hue, saturation, and luminance ranges.

controls.asserts: cop/chromakey is CRLF -- recorded, and parsed anyway
controls.fails_if: line endings are absorbed before being measured, hiding the hazard

controls.asserts: cop/chromakey -- the nested 'TIP:' block is folded into its parent, not counted
controls.fails_if: a nested box is promoted to a parameter, inflating the count

controls.asserts: cop2/emboss RAW -- the 10 hand-read labels at indent 4 (cop2 is not column-0)
controls.fails_if: the item base indent is assumed rather than resolved per scope

controls.asserts: cop2/emboss -- internal names arrive via #channels, and there are ZERO #id
controls.fails_if: the reader follows only #id and reports the cop2 surface as un-identifiable

controls.asserts: cop2/emboss ships a BOM -- and its first directive survives decoding
controls.fails_if: the corpus decodes plain utf-8, leaving U+FEFF at offset 0 and eating '#type: node'

controls.asserts: cop2/emboss 'Specular Model' is documented BY ITS MENU VALUES
controls.fails_if: menu values are dropped instead of folded, scoring a documented parameter as a stub

controls.asserts: lop/distantlight -- 0 parameters as it ships, 87 once includes resolve
controls.fails_if: include resolution is skipped, reporting a fully-documented node as ungrounded

controls.asserts: lop/distantlight is TITLE-first -- directives are not assumed to lead the file
controls.fails_if: the header block is read from the top of the file, losing #context/#internal on 79% of lop pages

controls.asserts: lop/distantlight's one broken include is MARKED and counted, never dropped
controls.fails_if: an unresolvable target is silently deleted, turning an undercount into a clean-looking parse

controls.asserts: cop/adjacency_distort 'Signature' has NO inline prose -- #contentfrom supplies it
controls.fails_if: the #contentfrom axis is not followed, scoring documented parameters as described-by-nothing

controls.asserts: sop/xform 'Combine' keys to 'combine' -- NOT to the Vimeo video id on the page
controls.fails_if: a ':vimeo:' block does not close the item scope and its '#id: 406959576' re-keys a real parameter

controls.asserts: the new Copernicus nodes, from the SHIPPED news.zip -- BOTH link forms
controls.fails_if: the what's-new extraction over- or under-counts, or the shipped page stops naming node paths

controls.asserts: a leading-slash-only link pattern returns 161 and drops 10 real node types
controls.fails_if: both link forms turn out to name the same set, in which case 171 is wrong and the slash-only pattern was fine all along

controls.asserts: every node the slash-only pattern dropped HAS a page and CLEARS the floor
controls.fails_if: the 10 missed names are not real node pages, which would make 161 the right total

controls.asserts: lop/usd_rop -- ':import' is followed, and the @parameters header travels with the section
controls.fails_if: only ':include' is matched, or an imported @section body lands in the preamble where a parameter parser ignores it

controls.asserts: the deprecation banner target resolves -- it lives in composite.zip, NOT nodes.zip
controls.fails_if: the corpus opens only nodes.zip, reproducing H7-F4: a vendor-deprecated subsystem reads as current

controls.asserts: nodes.zip BOM count == 58, the figure I0 measured independently
controls.fails_if: this leg's corpus loader disagrees with I0's on the archive's own composition

controls.asserts: cop2/emboss is doc-deprecated by the banner, and the signal NAMES its source
controls.fails_if: the deprecation detector reports a bare boolean with no evidence of which side said so

controls.asserts: strip every #id: the 15 parameters SURVIVE (label is the key) and 0 ids remain
controls.fails_if: the parser is secretly keyed on #id -- the count would collapse with the ids

controls.asserts: rename @parameters: the parameter count goes to ZERO
controls.fails_if: the count is not actually measuring the @parameters section -- it would survive its removal

controls.asserts: remove the banner: doc-deprecation goes FALSE
controls.fails_if: the deprecation verdict is unfalsifiable -- it would report True on a clean page

controls.asserts: remove the summary: the rung falls ACTIONABLE -> EXISTS and the page stops clearing
controls.fails_if: the floor cannot fail -- every page would clear it regardless of content

controls.asserts: remove distantlight's includes: 87 parameters -> 0
controls.fails_if: the 87 are being invented somewhere other than include resolution

controls.asserts: a fabricated Copernicus name is ABSENT from the 161 and from the archive
controls.fails_if: the presence test says yes to everything, making '161 of 161' unfalsifiable

controls.asserts: strip descriptions only: 15 parameters remain but the rung falls to SUMMARY
controls.fails_if: the floor counts parameters rather than DOCUMENTED parameters -- a stub page would clear it

controls.asserts: a no-CRLF-normalisation reader finds 0 parameters on cop/chromakey; ours finds 15
controls.fails_if: the blind reader accidentally works -- then it is not demonstrating the hazard

controls.asserts: a plain-utf-8 reader loses emboss's '#type: node'; ours keeps it
controls.fails_if: the BOM stops being silent -- the decode would raise instead of succeeding wrongly

controls.asserts: a no-scope-close reader binds sop/xform's Vimeo VIDEO id onto 'Combine'; ours does not
controls.fails_if: the Vimeo trap stops reproducing -- then P5 is passing for no reason

controls.asserts: a nodes.zip-only corpus cannot resolve the deprecation banner; ours can
controls.fails_if: the banner target turns out to live in nodes.zip after all, and I0-F9 is wrong

controls.asserts: a ':include'-only reader loses every usd_rop parameter; ours keeps them
controls.fails_if: ':import' turns out to be decorative, and P7 is testing nothing

controls.asserts: without following #contentfrom, adjacency_distort 'Signature' is described by nothing
controls.fails_if: #contentfrom entries carry inline prose after all, and P4 is redundant

controls.asserts: a no-fold reader scores emboss 'Specular Model' as undocumented; ours documents it
controls.fails_if: the entry carries inline prose after all, so the fold pass is not what rescues it
